title: 2.1.31 Branch with ||
description: Write an if statement whose condition combines two checks with ||. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: book 2.1.8 — 'Combining Conditions', Example 2.9: Either condition is enough

steps.title: Declare two variables
steps.instructions: Create two variables — for example, isWeekend and isHoliday — and give each a value (true or false, or numbers you can compare).

steps.title: Branch with ||
steps.instructions: Write an if statement whose condition uses || so that the if block runs when at least one of your checks is true. Inside the if block, log a message saying at least one condition is true.
